question: In which year was the Training of Rural Youth for Self Employment (TRYSEM) scheme launched by Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **1979**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **TRYSEM** stands for **Training of Rural Youth for Self Employment**.
 
• The scheme was launched in the year **1979** by the Government of India.
 
• The main objective was to provide technical and entrepreneurial skills to rural youth.
 
• It aimed to improve the employability of rural youth and reduce rural unemployment.
 
• TRYSEM was later merged with other schemes to form the **Swarna Jayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY)** in 1999.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Program
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **TRYSEM**
 A scheme aimed at providing technical and entrepreneurial training to rural youth to improve their employability.
 
 

 **SGSY**
 A scheme that merged TRYSEM and other rural development programs to create a holistic approach to rural employment and poverty alleviation.
 
 

 **NRLM**
 The National Rural Livelihoods Mission, which aims to reduce poverty by enabling the poor households to access gainful self-employment and skilled wage employment opportunities.
 
 

 **PMKVY**
 Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana, a scheme to provide skill training to youth across the country, including rural areas.
